title: first_n off-by-one slice
description: first_n(items, n) should return the first n items, but the slice uses n-1 and returns one too few.

hidden_tests.test_slicing.py:
from slicing import first_n


def test_first_n():
    assert first_n([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) == [1, 2]
    assert first_n([1, 2, 3], 3) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert first_n([9], 1) == [9]
